edges.parent_basis:
The motu proprio names its predecessor and disposes of it: it declares that the
general Decree of the Sacred Congregation of Rites of 23 March 1955 De rubricis
ad simpliciorem formam redigendis ceases to be in force, having been taken up
into this new redaction of the rubrics. An act that says what it supersedes has
drawn its own edge.
